# Third-party art

## LegacyFantasy/
"Legacy Fantasy - High Forest" (v2.3), free asset pack from itch.io (Legacy Fantasy series by Anokolisa).
Used for backgrounds, trees, foliage and props. Confirm the itch.io page's terms before release; credit in the game's credits.

## HumblePaperUI/
"Humble Gift - Paper UI System" (v1.1) by Humble Pixel (humblepixel.itch.io). Credit appreciated: @Humblepixel.
License: may be used in commercial and non-commercial projects and modified. May NOT be redistributed, shared or
resold in any form (original or modified) and may not be used in a logo or trademark.
=> Keep this repository private (or keep these files out of any public copy).

Only the sheets the game uses were copied from the original downloads. Import settings are applied automatically by
Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/ThirdPartyArtImporter.cs (32 PPU, point filter, uncompressed).
